mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at a chilly 33 degrees at Harriet Park under clear skies with a Waning Crescent moon visible.

The Plan Commission meets this Monday to discuss several pending projects, including a site plan and conditional use permit for Sub-Zero in the Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the city is consistently updating engineering reports through AECOM to ensure our infrastructure remains in top shape.
There is plenty to do in our area, starting with Live Music at Bailey's Run today. Tomorrow, you can head over to the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol Square.
In a notable call from the past week, on Sunday, October 19, officers took a 49-year-old man into custody during a traffic stop for a suspended license and an outstanding warrant.
Today's flavor is Chocolate Volcano, which is always a local favorite. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and satisfy your cravings.
